LORE: It is before the incident. The universes lived in peace as their protector defeated any darkness that were a threat to the multiverse itself. After many many years of never ending peace due to their prominent protector, following it's own purpose, A darkness known as 'Chaos' has consumed all power from the fallen, and has defeated the protector. You must defeat chaos, and bring back the light into these worlds. You are our only hope.

ABOUT: Chaos RPG is a modern RPG heavily inspired by Lords of the multiverse RPG and TLC RPG. It includes many realms to conquer, Many challenging bosses you can slay, And many weapons you can Starlight...
